COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and relative neutropenia and lymphopenia, with elevated monocytes and basophils. Ferritin and INR are significantly elevated. Mildly increased albumin and chloride are noted. These findings may indicate acute systemic inflammation or infection (possibly viral), with evidence of coagulopathy and hypoxemia. Clinical correlation and further evaluation for causes such as severe infection (e.g., COVID-19), sepsis, or hematologic disorders are recommended.
